Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
During an action, Henry Taylor (controlled by you) plays Shape
Mastery at superior (i.e., as a reaction card) to cancel a Shadow
Play.

Can you move that Shape Mastery from your ash heap to the top
of your library after that action?

I guess he cannot, because he did not play Shape Mastery as
a combat card, but as a reaction card, and Henry Taylor's
text reads: "... a combat card Henry played during that action...".

Name: Shape Mastery
[BH:R]
Cardtype: Combat/Reaction
Discipline: Protean
[pro] Cancel a combat card that requires Obtenebration [obt], Protean, or
Vicissitude [vic] as it is played (no cost is paid). The opposing minion cannot
play that card again this action.
[PRO] As above, but cancel an action modifier that requires any of those
Disciplines.

Name: Henry Taylor
[BH:U2]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Brujah antitribu
Group: 3
Capacity: 6
Discipline: cel pre pro POT
Sabbat: After an action, you may move a combat card Henry played during that
action from your ash heap to the top of your library.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>I guess he cannot, because he did not play Shape Mastery as
>a combat card, but as a reaction card, and Henry Taylor's
>text reads: "... a combat card Henry played during that action...".

But when Henry plays it, it is only as a reaction card, it does not count as a
combat card. Thus it does not qualify. Similarly, if he played a Swallowed by
the Night for stealth and was blocked, he coudln't retrieve that either.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Correct.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In all cases, a card that isn't played as an action modifier doesn't
count as an action modifier. In all cases, only action modifiers count
as action modifiers.


Messages.Author: Eric Simon
Messages.Body:
salem <salem_ch...@yahoo.com> wrote in message news:<ondcuvcsnoah0r4sa...@4ax.com>...


Card Text:

Chiram's Hold
Combat
Cost: 1 blood

Requires a ready vampire in combat with an acting minion. Only usable
before range is determined.

Give this card to the controller of the acting minion and move a
combat card from that Methuselah's ash heap to this card. The chosen
combat card costs that Methuselah's vampires an additional blood. That
Methuselah may burn this card by discarding a copy of the chosen
combat card during his or her discard phase. A Methuselah can have
only 1 Chiram's Hold.

Note text: "The chosen COMBAT card". Answer - no. When SbtN is
played as an action mod, it is not being played as a combat card,
therefore it does not cost extra.
